notes: Commercial APC propeller tested in UIUC Vol. 1 (Brandt 2005 / Brandt & Selig 2011, data ver. 3 with the 2015 motor-fixture drag correction). Geometry = APC's own design file (current release v2025-1001); APC revises designs, so the specimen tested in 2005-2008 may differ slightly: the UIUC PropellerScanner geometry of the tested specimen is in extraction/geometry_uiuc_scan.csv and is compared in extraction/check_uiuc_apce_10x7.png. Airfoils are KNOWN from the APC file (not assumed): APC file: AIRFOIL1 E63 at 1.10 in, AIRFOIL2 APC12 at 3.66 in; anchors: e63_t16p6 at r/R=0.220 (f=0.00, t/c=0.166); e63naca4412_f0p33_t11p4 at r/R=0.388 (f=0.33, t/c=0.114); e63naca4412_f0p66_t10p5 at r/R=0.559 (f=0.66, t/c=0.105); e63naca4412_f1p00_t10p1 at r/R=0.730 (f=1.00, t/c=0.101). ASSUMPTIONS in the airfoil model: (1) APC 'scales airfoils based on thickness ratio' - taken as thickness-only scaling (camber line kept); (2) the AIRFOIL1->AIRFOIL2 transition is a linear blend in r of camber line and thickness shape; (3) sections are modelled by a few XFOIL anchor sections with linear cl/cd transitions between them. Published BEM validations of APC thin-electric props used NACA 4412 outboard (McCrink & Gregory 2017: Clark-Y 0-5 % span, NACA 4412 elsewhere, from cutting the blades), consistent with APC's APC12 = NACA 4412. Polars: XFOIL Ncrit = 9 (UIUC tunnel Tu < 0.1 %), Ncrit = 5 alternatives listed. Rhub = first geometry station (0.15 R). Fluid: rho = 1.17 kg/m3, nu = 1.55e-5 m2/s assumed (UIUC lab, the database gives coefficients only). Chord Re at 0.75R ranges ~42k-69k (c75 = 17.1 mm, 0.75*Omega*R at the lowest/highest tested rpm).
